verdict.rationale: Riveter offers cost controls like dry_run estimates and max_credits caps that refuse overpriced requests, but there is no evidence the API automatically searches for or selects the cheapest configuration that still succeeds — it only estimates/caps, it doesn't auto-optimize. Missing for 10: any documentation of automatic configuration search/optimization for cost, fallback logic that retries cheaper options, or an API parameter that lets Riveter choose the minimal successful config itself.
